content.short: STAN is an esports fan engagement platform on Polygon that enables users to collect and trade digital cards.
content.description: STAN is a pioneering blockchain-based esports fan engagement platform designed to bridge the gap between creators and their communities, with a primary focus on the Indian gaming market. Built natively on the Polygon network, the platform allows fans to purchase and trade 'Limited Digital Cards' of their favorite esports stars, providing them with true digital ownership of collectible assets. STAN features a highly accessible interface that supports traditional payment methods. Holding cards grants fans access to exclusive perks like live voice rooms and meets with top esports talent.
content.meta: STAN offers esports fan engagement and NFT-based digital card trading on Polygon. Discover STAN and more on the Lancers Web3 Explorer.
